issues.extracted: 41 governmental receipt lines and 21 disbursement lines taken per fund (General Fund from p24 Total column, Street p17, Sales Tax p18, Econ Dev p20, Grant p21, Nonmajor p22, CDA p5), with fund names added to labels, e.g. 'Property (General Fund)'
issues.on_page: Total Governmental Funds column p6: Property 355,877, Motor vehicle 46,926, Intergovernmental 628,082, Charges for services 105,920, Grants 372,102, Loan repayment 184,039, Interest income 43,181, Contributions 74,317, Sales/insurance proceeds 74,429, Other 6,848 ... total 2,816,066; expenditures total 3,511,494
issues.issue: The rules call for one line per row of the Total Governmental Funds column. The extractor used per-fund lines instead, and the labels are not exactly as printed. I checked every per-fund amount against its page and they add up to the printed totals 2,816,066 and 3,511,494. So the deviation is in form only, and it gives finer categories.

issues.on_page: Loan repayment: Sales Tax 14,308, Economic Development 73,853, CDA 95,878 (total 184,039, receipts[21], [25], [36])
issues.issue: These are collections of loan principal receivable. The statement counts them as revenue, but they arguably aren't revenue. They make up most of the governmental 'other' total (about 191k of 2.82M). Each line is marked review, but there is no decision_needed entry. Judgment call.

issues.on_page: Cash and cash equivalents 229,604; County treasurer cash 19,997; Restricted cash 1,158,364; Restricted certificates of deposit 942,015 (Total Governmental Funds)
issues.issue: ending_cash uses only the unrestricted cash line. It leaves out county treasurer cash and restricted cash/CDs, although total assets of 2,349,980 are essentially all cash. Defensible, but it understates governmental cash.

issues.on_page: Sales/insurance proceeds 29,427 (27,848 of it in Ambulance); CDA Sales/insurance proceeds 29,002 (receipts[39])
issues.issue: The line mixes sale proceeds and insurance proceeds, and insurance proceeds would be reimbursements/refunds. The Statement of Activities (p3) shows only a 5,058 gain on disposal. Already marked review.

issues.on_page: Statement p5 General Fund Public works 28,326; budget schedule p15 Total public works 28,325 (Zoning 796 + Cemetery 27,529, also p23-24)

issues.on_page: Salaries and benefits (all 10 General Fund departments, total 636,062)
issues.issue: [fixed 2026-10-21: review flags / rounding discrepancy recorded] The line combines salaries and benefits, and it was put under salaries and wages without a review flag. This is the dominant category, so it is defensible.
